title: 为大语言模型引入卷积
summary: 研究在Qwen3 Transformer块中17个位置应用轻量级深度可分离卷积，发现对注意力前的QKV投影进行卷积效果最佳。采用核大小k=3的残差深度卷积，无需额外归一化或激活函数，在增加不到0.01%参数的情况下，提升七个下游基准平均准确率。卷积使重复token对其上下文更敏感，作为自注意力的轻量级补充。
summary_en: Studies applying lightweight depthwise convolutions at 17 locations in a Qwen3 Transformer block, finding best results on projected QKV before attention. A residual depthwise conv with kernel size 3, no extra norm/activation, improves average accuracy on 7 benchmarks while adding <0.01% parameters. Convolution makes repeated tokens more context-sensitive, serving as a lightweight complement to self-attention.
